license: CC BY 4.0 (SLAKE items) and CC0 1.0 (Brain Tumor MRI items)
scope: 50 diagnosis cases: chest X-ray and CT findings from SLAKE (huggingface.co/datasets/BoKelvin/SLAKE; images with one labeled disease), brain MRI from the Brain Tumor MRI Dataset (kaggle.com/datasets/masoudnickparvar/brain-tumor-mri-dataset; via huggingface.co/datasets/AIOmarRehan/Brain_Tumor_MRI_Dataset). Options are diagnoses of the same organ and a normal option; source.dataset gives the origin per item.
attribution: SLAKE: A Semantically-Labeled Knowledge-Enhanced Dataset for Medical Visual Question Answering (Liu et al., ISBI 2021); Brain Tumor MRI Dataset (M. Nickparvar, 2021), from figshare (Cheng et al.), SARTAJ and Br35H
